options.html:
OIGE

OIGE

QKJH

QKJH

SMLJ    

SMLJ

WQPN

WQPN

questions.solution:
First alphabet - 9 = Fourth alphabet and Second alphabet - 1 = Third
alphabet
QKJH ⇒ {Q - 9 = H and K - 1 = J}
SMLJ ⇒ {S - 9 = J and M - 1 = L}
WQPN ⇒ {W - 9 = N and Q - 1 = P}
But in OIGE ⇒{O - 10 = E and I - 2 = G}

पहला अक्षर - 9 = चौथा अक्षर और दूसरा अक्षर - 1 = तीसरा अक्षर
QKJH ⇒ {Q - 9 = H और K - 1 = J}
SMLJ ⇒ {S - 9 = J और M - 1 = L}
WQPN ⇒ {W - 9 = N और Q - 1 = P}
लेकिन OIGE में ⇒{O - 10 = E और I - 2 = G}
